final: SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS distinct_orders, 1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, 1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) / AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault)) OVER () AS ratio_to_scope_average FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope
